'''House Kazadi''' is one of the known [[Nobility|Noble]] [[House]]s of [[Saldaea]].

The only known member of the House is its High Seat, [[Tenobia Kazadi]], the late queen of Saldaea. It is unknown if the House has survived beyond its last High Seat, as the throne has passed to [[House Bashere]] under Queen [[Faile Bashere|Zarine]].
